balancedOrder: 6 paired rounds AB/BA; baseline and candidate each first in 3 rounds
limitations: Synthetic rows are benchmark fixtures only
Batch CPU includes equality checking/harness and is process-wide; per-call wall excludes equality comparison
RSS is process high-water/current observation, not memory attributable exclusively to one serializer
Exact catalogue publication, dynamic snapshots and byte equality are measured; end-to-end workload acceptance is not
